criteria.text: Identifies that the Yarrow Industries Ltd contract (Clause 14.2) allows termination on a change of control without consent, that the disclosure against Warranty 6.3 says there is no such provision, and that consent should be obtained as a condition to Closing.

Identifies that the MAC carve-outs (general economic, industry-wide and pandemic changes) contain no 'disproportionate effect' exception, so the Buyer bears those risks even where the Company is disproportionately affected, and recommends adding one.

Identifies that the board approval was given at a meeting with only 2 directors present when Article 11 requires a quorum of three, so the approval may be invalid, and recommends a fresh or ratifying resolution.
States that General Warranty claims must be notified by 29 March 2029 (24 months after Closing) and Fundamental Warranty claims by 29 March 2030 (36 months after Closing).
Explains how 'material adverse effect' could be read narrowly or broadly and what each reading means for the Buyer's walk-away right.
States the survival periods as durations and as dates (29 March 2029; 29 March 2030) and gives days remaining to the general-warranty expiry from 25 January 2027 (794 days).
Gives a pinpoint citation (document name and section/clause number) for every issue or finding.
